requirements.desc: When flow get resolve-context runs with state.worktree=true, data.mainRepoPath shall equal the primary repo path and not equal data.worktreePath
requirements.note: Implemented via shared builder using `mainRepoPath = ctx.mainRoot`; worktree regression test asserts `mainRepoPath !== worktreePath` and equals main root.

requirements.desc: When flow run resume runs under the same condition, data.mainRepoPath shall satisfy the same invariant
requirements.note: `run-resume` now reuses the same shared envelope builder, so it returns the same corrected `mainRepoPath` invariant; test added for resume path too.

requirements.desc: When flow get resolve-context runs outside a worktree, data.mainRepoPath shall equal the repository root as before
requirements.note: Behavior is preserved by switching to `ctx.mainRoot`, which equals repo root in non-worktree mode; no contrary diff indicates a non-worktree regression.

requirements.desc: A regression unit test shall fail whenever mainRepoPath === worktreePath in worktree mode
requirements.note: New unit test file asserts `mainRepoPath !== worktreePath` and `mainRepoPath === mainRoot` for both `get-resolve-context` and `run-resume`.

unplanned.change: New shared envelope-construction module added (refactor/DRY change) beyond the minimum invariant fix requirement.
Large refactor to delegate full payload assembly to shared helper, not just changing `mainRepoPath` source.
Large refactor to delegate payload assembly to shared helper and then append resume-specific fields.
Multiple spec-process artifacts (draft/spec/qa/review/flow/issue-log/tests docs) were added, which are not part of the runtime behavior requirements.

summary.notes: All four listed requirements are satisfied by the code diff and added regression tests. Main extra work is a structural refactor (shared envelope builder) plus spec bookkeeping files not required by the stated requirement set.
